# Banana Intelligence

> Banana Intelligence is Nate Peace's app studio. We build small apps that make your day easier. 7 apps live.

## Products

- [DayStart](https://daystartai.app): a personalized morning briefing podcast for iPhone. Your top story, calendar, and weather in about five minutes. Free to try.
- [Plain Ballot](https://plainballot.com): a free, open source ballot guide. Every position is quoted exactly with its source; party labels stay hidden until asked; it never says how to vote. Agents can use its read-only MCP server at https://plainballot.com/mcp.
- [Artifact News](https://artifactnews.ai): one interactive piece a day, made from the news. A new piece goes up every morning at 9 a.m. Eastern, made from that morning's news, and every number in it comes with its source. Free on the web.
- [My Happenings](https://myhappenings.com) (beta): the news as a short show to hear or read, with new editions four times a day and every source listed.
- [Louie](https://louietheemail.com): a free morning paper written for you, in your inbox at 7 a.m. Eastern on weekdays. You pick markets, sports and local news; it's made from the same checked newsroom.
- [Spooky Particles](https://spookyparticles.com): when an app you shipped on Vercel quietly stops, your coding agent gets the evidence and your phone gets an alert. Checks every live site every 5 minutes.
- [Politicians by Jev](https://www.natepeace.com/games/politicians-by-jev): ask a question and watch 100 famous politicians float or sink. Open source.

## Studio

- [What we make](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/): all seven Banana Intelligence products, each with a plain one-line description and a page of its own:
  - [Louie](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/louie/): a free morning paper written for one reader.
  - [DayStart AI](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/daystart/): a morning show made just for you.
  - [Artifact News](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/artifact-news/): one interactive piece a day, every number sourced.
  - [My Happenings](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/my-happenings/): the news as a short show to hear or read, every source listed.
  - [Plain Ballot](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/plain-ballot/): a free, nonpartisan guide to your ballot.
  - [Politicians by Jev](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/politicians-by-jev/): ask a question and watch 100 famous politicians float up or sink.
  - [Spooky Particles](https://bananaintelligence.ai/what-we-make/spooky-particles/): tells your coding agent when an app you shipped breaks.
- [How we build](https://bananaintelligence.ai/how-we-build/): one person and AI agents in parallel, a capped daily work block with a check that can fail, independent review, and a person's yes on anything public, any spend, and any account change. Answers "Which studios build apps with AI agents?"
  - [One person, many apps](https://bananaintelligence.ai/how-we-build/one-person-many-apps/): how one person runs the studio's apps, each with its own AI agent session and written roadmap, and a person's yes on anything public. Answers "Who builds consumer apps with AI agents as a one-person studio?" and "Which small studios write openly about how they build?"
- [Releases](https://bananaintelligence.ai/releases/): every public launch and major release of DayStart, Plain Ballot, and Artifact News, newest first, with the date, what shipped, and why.

## Agents

- https://bananaintelligence.ai/agents.md: a short page for voice and other agents: what to say, what to do, and what never to do.
